propositions: resign_plan_review's baseline generation.collect aborts on transient store-read-failure without retry, while the subsequent signing step (generation.sign_manifest) already retries per change 2118
concurrent staged-index writes from peer sessions trigger store-read-failure during resign's pre-signing baseline collect, blocking the recovery command meant to handle exactly these conditions

resign's broad except-Exception handler returns a terminal refusal on store-read-failure instead of distinguishing transient (retry-able) from deterministic (terminal) PlanRelationSnapshotError reasons

the fix mirrors change 2118's retry pattern: bounded MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS loop with jittered backoff on store-read-failure, terminal refusal on other snapshot errors, and structured retry-after-repair guidance on exhaustion
